listing.name: Mining Strength Tooltips v1.0
listing.summary: Displays mining strength values directly in weapon stats and expanded descriptions.
listing.aiSummary: Displays mining strength values directly in weapon stats and expanded descriptions.

description:
Pretty much what it says on the tin, adds a reasonably convenient method of displaying mining strength (added by

Nexerelin

) to the player. Has

LunaLib

support for editing the config in-game.

You can download it from GitHub here.

Nexerelin and LunaLib should both be soft dependencies if I set it up right, though why you wouldn't use the mod it adds info from is beyond me.

Aight, as to why I made this. If you've played with Nexerelin and tried to figure out mining with a bunch of mods installed, you probably already know, but for those that don't, the only way to see mining strength normally is by attempting to mine something and then opening the big list of fighters, weapons, and ships that add mining strength. I've got a lot of mods installed, and so my list is pretty big. I had three screenshots of just the weapons and fighters from one faction trying to figure out what the best stuff to equip was, having given up trying to optimize fully. A bit annoying, and sometime in the next few days I went "wait, that'd be pretty easy to add huh" and this thing was born. My coding knowledge is pretty much just Python, so this whole thing was made by Claude, apologies if that's a problem for anyone. Do note that it currently only displays in the weapon stats (in the refit menu) and in the

expanded description

(the codex one in F2), not on the floating description, might add that later. Suppose I could also just make a PR for this over on Nexerelin too, huh. Also never used a forum before, for those wondering why my formatting is horrid.

AI Code Disclaimer:
The code for this mod was created using Claude Opus 5.5, since I suck at Java.

aiDescription: Adds a convenient way to view mining strength without opening the full list of contributing items. The values appear in the refit menu's weapon stats and in the codex expanded description. It supports in-game configuration editing via LunaLib.
